female.sp: Heingra, CCP-068, Dominicus escort mass-production mobile suit. Use both attached official front and rear views as mechanical design authority. Preserve sand-tan armor, dark muted plum structural sections, white upper-arm and shield panels, purple optical sensors, the enormous circular shoulder drums under squared tan caps, compact angular chest plates, large round violet hip armor, circular tan knee guards and narrow tan shin guards. Her RIGHT hand holds the long dark-gray dedicated beam rifle; keep the whole rifle inside frame. Her LEFT forearm carries the tall asymmetric shield with tan outer armor, a white central plate and a large circular tan mechanism containing three small dark apertures; keep the whole shield inside frame and do not turn it into a generic rectangle. Preserve the boxy dark-gray backpack, two long beam-saber handles rising behind both shoulders, and the distinctive twin horizontal cylindrical rear thruster tanks spanning behind her hips; these must remain readable as external equipment rather than wings or a tail. Translate the purple head sensor into a compact practical hair ornament, leaving a fully human face unobstructed; no Gundam V-fin. Keep the massive shoulder armor, shield, forearm and knee plates while the open fitted design exposes collarbone, waist flanks and upper-thigh gaps between substantial plates. Front-facing full-body portrait with face, torso, rifle, shield, both feet and the outer edges of the rear thruster cylinders visible with generous margins. Pose otherwise freely chosen. No letters, model numbers, insignia, logos or background text. Face distinction: a clearly adult Southeast Asian woman in her twenties with tan skin, a short wide softly rounded face, narrow level violet eyes, broad low nose bridge, fuller lower lip, soft jaw, and thick black hair in two compact space buns with choppy bangs. She has an average-height toned athletic build, broad shoulders and powerful legs. Do not resemble the pilot or any previous character. The first attached anthropomorphized image is the identity anchor for this SAME adult woman, preserving her exact short wide softly rounded face, violet eyes, tan skin, black space buns with choppy bangs, age and athletic body proportions. The official front and rear images anchor the mechanical equipment. Completely reinterpret the entire illustration in the selected high-end glossy Korean game-illustration style, including face, skin, armor, rifle, shield, thrusters and background with luminous polished rendering and refined graphic detail. Do not trace the first composition. Keep the selected front-facing view while allowing a naturally different stance.
